Title: Launch application

Test_Steps: 1. Run launch command 'python -m osdagbridge.desktop' or run app. 2. Observe splash screen and main window.
Expected_Result: Application window opens with Plate Girder Bridge workspace visible.
Actual_Result: Application launched cleanly and UI loaded within 1.8s.

Title: Leave required field empty

Test_Steps: 1. Run design with IRC_Class_70R_Tracked. 2. Compare delta_ll against L/800.
Expected_Result: delta_ll must be less than 30mm for safe rating.

Title: Material grade capacity sensitivity

Expected_Result: Capacity ratio M_E350 / M_E250 equals exactly 350 / 250 (1.40).
Actual_Result: Ratio computed: 1.400; material yield scaling verified exactly.
